Master Software Requirements Specification (SRS)

Comprehensive Office Management System (OMS)With Supply Chain, IT/MIS & Enterprise GPS Tracking - Version 2.0

1. System Overview

The Office Management System (OMS) is an enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS application designed to centralize and automate organizational workflows. It provides a unified responsive web dashboard and a cross-platform mobile application. The system integrates Human Resources, Fleet & Vehicle Logistics, Facilities Administration, Task Execution, Finance, Procurement & Supply Chain, and CRM/Sales Operations into a single ecosystem. A dedicated IT & MIS (Management Information System) module powers a global executive dashboard with live map integrations. To ensure uncompromising data accuracy for management, the system features silent, background GPS tracking for all field-based entities (Drivers, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Field Teams) managed via Enterprise/MDM deployment.

2. User Roles & Permissions Matrix

The system relies on a granular RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) architecture to ensure data privacy and hierarchical operational flow. Expanded roles include:

Super Admin (SaaS Platform Owner): Manages global platform settings, onboard/offboard tenant companies, and oversees global subscription billing.

Company Admin / Management (Tenant Owner): Full administrative control. Accesses the Global Executive Dashboard (MIS) to view company-wide analytics, live map tracking, and overall operational health.

IT & MIS Manager: Oversees system data integrity, user access, and analytics dashboards. Responsible for the IT/HR technology alignment and maintaining the live map and global tracking metrics.

Procurement & Supply Chain Manager: Manages vendor relationships, purchase orders, inventory levels, logistics routing, and supply chain timelines.

HR Manager / HR Admin: Manages the Employee Directory, onboarding, attendance tracking, leave approvals, and payroll data.

Finance / Accounts Manager: Manages General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, and expense claim verifications.

Operations / Fleet Manager: Administers the vehicle registry, approves requisition requests, and schedules fleet maintenance.

Sales, Marketing & Field Visit Team: Executes field operations, logs client meetings, and submits field data. Their mobile app automatically logs routes and client visit coordinates.

Driver: Operates company vehicles. Mobile app provides route details and runs continuous background GPS logging.

Standard Employee: Accesses a personal self-service dashboard for internal tasks (leave, expenses, room booking).

3. Detailed Module Specifications

### 3.1 IT & MIS (Global Management Dashboard)

The nerve center for company management, maintained by the IT & MIS team.• Global Executive Dashboard: High-level overview of HR attendance, daily sales metrics, procurement bottlenecks, and fleet utilization.• Live Operations Map: A real-time geographic map displaying the exact locations of all active company vehicles (Drivers), Supply Chain deliveries, Sales, Marketing, and Field Visit Teams.• Data Governance: Centralized control for the IT team to manage data backups, audit logs, and cross-departmental data flow.

### 3.2 Enterprise Background GPS Tracking Engine

Ensures accurate, untampered visibility of field operations for management.• Silent Background Tracking: The mobile app (when deployed via corporate Mobile Device Management - MDM) collects exact GPS coordinates at regular intervals without repeatedly prompting the user for permission.• Route Mapping & Geofencing: Automatically draws travel routes on the MIS map. Triggers alerts if a Supply Chain truck or Field Sales rep deviates from their assigned territory.• Proof of Presence: Automatically logs timestamps and coordinates when a Field Team member marks a task or meeting as 'Completed'.

### 3.3 Procurement & Supply Chain Management

End-to-end management of materials and logistics.• Vendor Management & Sourcing: Database of approved suppliers, rating systems, and historical pricing.• Purchase Orders (PO): Automated PO generation with multi-tier financial approval workflows.• Inventory & Warehousing: Real-time stock levels, low-stock alerts, and batch tracking.• Logistics Tracking: Integrates with the GPS engine to track the real-time movement of goods from warehouse to destination.

### 3.4 Human Resources & Leave Management

Centralizes employee lifecycle tracking and attendance automation.• Time & Attendance: Geo-fenced mobile check-in/check-out. Records 8-hour tracking logs and computes custom overtime formulas.• Multi-Layer Leave Approvals: Configurable workflows (e.g., Employee -> Line Manager -> HR).

### 3.5 Vehicle & Fleet Management

Logistics tracking for company-owned vehicles.• Driver & Vehicle Assignments: Links specific drivers to vehicles and trips.• Requisition & Logs: Calendar-based booking, digital trip logs (odometer/fuel), and maintenance scheduling.

### 3.6 Sales, Marketing & Field Operations

• CRM Pipeline: Visual deal stages and lead source tracking.• Field Activity Logging: Marketing and Sales teams use the app to log client visits, which are automatically verified against their silent GPS coordinates on the MIS map.
